ruleset.name: nitpicker-test-rules
ruleset.description: Nitpicker's PMD rules for test sources.

rule.name: FixedSleepInTest
rule.message: A fixed sleep makes the test slow and flaky. Wait on the condition: check it in a while loop against a deadline (a sleep inside that loop is allowed), or use verify(mock, timeout(1000)) for a mock. If a real wait is unavoidable, add an exception for pmd/FixedSleepInTest in nitpicker.config.json.

property.name: xpath
property.value: ( //MethodCall[pmd-java:matchesSig('java.lang.Thread#sleep(long)') or pmd-java:matchesSig('java.lang.Thread#sleep(long,int)') or pmd-java:matchesSig('java.lang.Thread#sleep(java.time.Duration)') or pmd-java:matchesSig('java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit#sleep(long)')] [not(ancestor::*[self::WhileStatement or self::DoStatement or self::LambdaExpression or self::MethodDeclaration or self::ConstructorDeclaration][1] [self::WhileStatement or self::DoStatement])] | //MethodCall[@MethodName = 'waitForTimeout'] [*[1][pmd-java:typeIs('com.microsoft.playwright.Page') or pmd-java:typeIs('com.microsoft.playwright.Frame')]] | //MethodCall[@MethodName = 'until'] [*[1][pmd-java:typeIs('org.awaitility.core.ConditionFactory')]] [ArgumentList/LambdaExpression/BooleanLiteral[@True = true()]] )

rule.name: NegativeWaitInTest
rule.message: Do not prove that something does not happen by waiting out a delay: after(ms) and during(...) pass only after the full wait, so the test is slow and depends on the timing. Give the code a Clock or a scheduler the test controls, move it past the delay and assert at once. If a real wait is unavoidable, add an exception for pmd/NegativeWaitInTest in nitpicker.config.json.
